visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens behind a black safety net overlooking a baseball field at night. A group of men dressed in casual sportswear and caps are standing near the fence, their backs to the camera, cheering and waving their hands enthusiastically toward the field. A man wearing a white suit with a red sash across his shoulder walks across the grass toward the spectators. The stadium is brightly lit by high-intensity overhead lights, creating a slightly hazy or foggy atmosphere in the background where rows of stadium seating are visible. (2) The man in the white suit approaches the group at the fence and reaches over to embrace one of the spectators in a deep hug. Other men in the foreground are holding up smartphones to record the moment. White variety-style captions appear at the top and middle of the frame, providing context to the actions. The camera angle is relatively steady, focused on the interaction across the barrier. (3) The perspective shifts to a closer eye-level view on the field. The man in the white suit is now holding a microphone and addressing the large crowd. He waves his arm toward the stands while speaking. In the background, camera operators and stadium staff are visible on the grass. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the man's white attire against the green turf and gray stadium structure.
